121.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
121.text: “Ha! You could say that. After eleven daughters, courtesy of my eight wives -- all of whom I’m still married to -- I finally have a boy! Meet Wiktor Smolak II.”

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: “Impressive airship you have here, Mr. President.”

124.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
124.text: “It's my pride and joy, Your Majesty. Won it in a bet with Chancellor Hegel of Valgsland, though he won’t admit to it if you ask.”

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: It was then that I felt the airship begin its ascent. I looked out the window as the sprawling capital city beneath us became smaller and smaller.

126.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
126.text: “I hope you had a good rest, Your Majesty."

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: We took our seats in front of the window with a view just as fantastic as before.

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: Before taking a drink, I reached over and tapped my glass to the baby’s milk bottle, eliciting a roaring laugh from Smolak.

132.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
132.text: “Very good, Your Majesty! It’s refreshing to see a world leader who doesn't take himself seriously."

133.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
133.text: “I could invite Prime Minister Alvarez here, but he'd pay more attention to the liquor than the view."

134.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
134.text: “And Queen Beatrice? Ha! Forget about it."

135.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
135.text: "It’s as if they don’t want to be friends -- not like us.”

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "Do friends go over to each other's homes, only to become permanent residents, rearranging furniture, dictating house rules, and never leaving?"

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "I hope to have a son of my own someday."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "Interesting. I never took you for a family man."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Looks like even presidents have to multitask these days."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: “I suppose that depends on how you define friendship.”

155.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
155.text: “We signed an agreement regarding that very subject.”

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: “I seem to remember it being much longer. Dozens of pages longer, in fact."

157.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
157.text: “Let me fill you in on a little secret… you know, being friends and all...”

158.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
158.text: “I don’t read any of the bills or treaties that I put my name on. I have a whole department whose job it is to handle that.”

159.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
159.text: “I preferred the annotated version. Direct and to the point.”

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: “Then allow me to be direct and to the point. I'm here to ensure the removal of Wehlen forces from the territory of Zille. I hope this effort hasn't been in vain."

162.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
162.text: “Well, what are we waiting for? Let's get to it!"

163.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
163.text: “We made an agreement, Your Majesty. I believe we both remember its terms."

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: Smolak sipped his drink before pulling out a cocktail napkin from his jacket pocket. There was vague scribblings on it.

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: He held up the napkin, where I could make out a list of the terms to our amended treaty.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: He waved his napkin around once more.

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: A brief moment of tension quickly subsided with a flash of the president's trademark smile.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: His attention returned to his napkin.

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "Please tell me we're not determining the fate of millions via a cocktail napkin."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "I honestly couldn't care less. You owe me a conversation about Zille."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Can we please get back on track? I fear we're moving in the wrong direction."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "Yes, I do. There was a security component."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "I'd prefer that we skip over this charade and get to where you tell me you'll hand Zille back to Rizia."

181.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
181.text: "Don't rush me, Your Majesty. You of all people should know about decorum and etiquette."

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "I'll leave it to the host's discretion."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Well, if that's the way you wish to proceed, then let's discuss security-related matters."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "I assure you, Mr. President, I am well versed in such matters and don't need a lecturing."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "I don't need lectures on decorum and etiquette, especially from you. You forget who you're speaking to."

190.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
190.text: "Let's take a step back and pretend the last thirty seconds never happened."

194.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
194.text: "Let's not start negotiations off on the wrong foot, shall we? We've only just begun."

195.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
195.text: "But for the sake of time, I'll kick things off with the issue of trade."

196.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
196.text: "Pending your objection, I'll go ahead and get to the issue of Wehlen-Rizian trade."

218.text: "Well, I never liked how this whole reunification mess started off in the first place!"

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "If you don't like the beginning, just wait until you see how it ends."

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "Hopefully the path ahead is more favorable to your liking."

224.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
224.text: "Please keep your voice down. You'll scare the baby."

227.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
227.text: "My people are very grateful for your generous wine shipments."

235.text: "Oh, is that what you're having? Nice touch."

247.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
247.text: "Soon, my morning routine will feel like a royal coronation!"

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "Forgive me, I'm trying to discern whether or not that was an insult or compliment."

252.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
252.text: "At least the intention behind it. I really am getting my bathroom remodeled in gold."

253.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
253.text: "Anyway, without getting further into the nitty-gritty of all the goods being exchanged across our borders, that covers the main points I wanted to address regarding trade."

310.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)

330.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
330.text: "Fortunately, Wehlen has reliable partners, such as Sordland, who also recognized the threat posed by the BFF."

331.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
331.text: "As a result of their cooperation, we were able to crush the Bludish Freedom Front entirely!"

332.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
332.text: "Thankfully, Wehlen can count on steadfast allies like Sordland, who acknowledge the danger posed by the BFF."

333.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
333.text: "While our operations are still ongoing, I have all the confidence that we will succeed."

334.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
334.text: "And, unfortunately, the problem is only getting worse."

335.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
335.text: "I appreciate the apology but, unfortunately, it doesn't do anything to change our current situation."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "Rizia's stance on this matter is clear. I don't feel the necessity to repeat myself."

340.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
340.text: "Careful with absolutes. You may find yourself boxed in by your own convictions."

341.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
341.text: "Maybe not now, but, nevertheless, I suggest keeping an open mind."

342.speaker: Player_Romus
342.text: "Careful, Smolak. Someone might get the idea that you have it out for the Bluds."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "You sure have it out for the Bluds, Mr. President."

347.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
347.text: "On the contrary, my focus is solely on safeguarding the security and prosperity of our nation."

348.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
348.text: "My focus is solely on safeguarding the security and prosperity of our nation."

349.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
349.text: "The actions against the Bluds are necessary measures to ensure Wehlen's stability."

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "I am pleased to hear it, but we must remain cautious. Crushing a movement is one thing, but killing an idea is another."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "Naturally, our leadership and prowess were the driving forces behind the crushing defeat, with Sordland merely tagging along."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "Indeed, our combined efforts have brought about a resounding victory!"

353.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
353.text: "Which is why Wehlen intends to focus on ensuring that the ideology fueling their cause dies alongside the BFF."

354.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
354.text: "Well, let us hope Sordland doesn't have spies among us to overhear your little insult."

355.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
355.text: "Though, just between us, Sordland overestimates its importance in such matters."

356.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
356.text: "Yes, a partnership that stands to open up new avenues for future collaboration."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "He's been deposed. That should still serve the same purpose."

359.speaker: Player_Romus
359.text: "I removed him from his leadership position in Iza. Given the circumstances, please know that was the extent of my ability to act."

360.speaker: Player_Romus
360.text: "Because the more I deliberated on it, the more I realized that the political fallout from arresting my cousin would be too great. It's as simple as that."

361.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
361.text: "Not only that.... he's marrying the Crown Princess! You royals and your strange traditions..."

365.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
365.text: "Needless to say, it was quite distressing to hear that particular piece of news."

366.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
366.text: "Yes, well apparently, Wehlen doesn't fall under what you consider 'political fallout.'"

367.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
367.text: "Invoking 'inability to act' is a sign of weakness. I do hope that moving forward, you'll find more *effective* ways to address such challenges."

368.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
368.text: "Don't confuse punishment with justice. They aren't interchangeable."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "As he should be. He might be flawed, but incarcerating him won't make your problems go away."

371.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
371.text: "Then you fail to see the impact of what one individual can do."

372.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
372.text: "And that won't benefit you in any way, regarding Zille."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "It gave me no pleasure to do so, but I'm a man of my word."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "Hopefully, his time will be well-spent contemplating the consequences of his actions."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "May he reflect on his misdeeds and seek redemption during his time of confinement."

379.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
379.text: "I couldn't care less what he contemplates. I'm just glad he's there."

380.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
380.text: "And for that, you have my respect."

826.text: "What's the rush? We've got plenty of time to talk. We've got a long flight ahead of us."

827.speaker: Narrator
827.text: Several hours later, I woke up to the site of a vast expanse of ocean appearing over the horizon. I had fallen asleep in one of the lounge chairs on the observation deck.

828.speaker: Narrator
828.text: I turned to see Smolak standing over me. Little Wiktor was in his arms.

831.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
831.text: "You wish to get straight to the point. Come with me."

832.speaker: Narrator
832.text: We made our way to a private room where drinks were already set out for us. Even the baby had a bottle waiting for him.

836.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
836.text: "His Majesty shall receive all the hydration he desires. Come with me."

837.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
837.text: "Great choice. We shall drink and converse like men."

838.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
838.text: "You do love wine in your country, don't you? Right this way."

839.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
839.text: "I confess I'm not much of a drinker, Your Majesty. Unless it's to butter up a potential trade partner. Shall we?"

840.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
840.text: "Patience is a virtue, Your Majesty. We haven't even taken off yet."

842.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
842.text: "Hey, take a step back. Relax and enjoy the ride! We've got a long flight ahead of us."

843.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
843.text: "You're the first world leader to share a ride on my airship."

845.speaker: Player_Romus
845.text: "Because I'm the only one who didn't turn down your invitation?"

846.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
846.text: "Actually, yes. Nobody wants go anywhere outside their council room walls. Everyone's so official and by the book."

847.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
847.text: "You should be. Everyone else is so official and by the book."

849.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
849.text: "What can I say, I have a way with people. Though, there are a rare few who don't seem to enjoy my company."

850.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
850.text: "Our two nations have been there for each other in the past. I see no reason why we can't continue that partnership now and in the years to come."

851.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
851.text: "Ah, I see what you did there. Someone wants to get right to talking about Zille."

852.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
852.text: "Very well. Let's get right to it then."

853.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
853.text: "Which is why we're here, so let's get into it."

857.speaker: Narrator
857.text: Smolak sipped his drink before pulling out a cocktail napkin from his jacket pocket. There was vague scribblings on it.

858.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
858.text: "If you remember, we signed an agreement regarding the conditions for Zille's return to Rizia."

859.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
859.text: "Oh, I never remember anything I sign. In fact, I'm going to fill you in on a little secret..."

860.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
860.text: "I beg your pardon. I'll try to use a chalkboard next time."

861.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
861.text: "As you can see, I made a few notes ahead of time. Though, it's a bit hard to read. Helps me be direct and to the point."

862.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
862.text: "Well, I for one define a friend as someone you can trust to be completely honest with you."

866.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
866.text: “So, where would you like to begin? Trade deals? Security pacts?"

867.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
867.text: "If that's the case, we can just skip ahead and get to the heart of the matter."

868.speaker: Narrator
868.text: He picked up a nearby telephone and spoke into it. Before long, a woman came in and took baby Wiktor away.

869.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
869.text: "I think we can make this brief."

870.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
870.text: "I left questioning whether or not Rizia could be trusted to uphold agreements or negotiate in good faith in general."

873.speaker: Player_Romus
873.text: "We do respect you. I'm here, aren't I?"

874.speaker: Player_Romus
874.text: "Words word words. That's all I'm hearing. Just get to the point and tell me if you'll uphold the treaty."

876.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
876.text: "Just because you're here doesn't make you a trusted ally. Those sorts of relationships take time."

886.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
886.text: "The sight of Zille takes my breath away every time I see it..."

887.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
887.text: "But given everything we've just discussed, I'm afraid I simply can't hand it over to you."

888.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
888.text: "However, I'll tell you what I will do. Because I'm a nice guy, I'm willing to let the people of Zille decide their leadership for themselves."

891.speaker: Narrator
891.text: Smolak shot me a dirty look.

893.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
893.text: "You also promised to provide us with military equipment. However, we're getting hardly any at all. I hear your stockpiles are running low?"
893.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGas"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGold"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportArms"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_WineIndustry_EnvironmentalDamage"] == true) == false)

894.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
894.text: "That's not good for either of us, is it?"

895.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
895.text: "You also promised to provide us with military equipment, which you've followed through on."
895.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGas"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGold"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportArms"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_WineIndustry_EnvironmentalDamage"] == true) == false)

896.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
896.text: "Given all of our ongoing conflicts... the more guns, the better."

900.speaker: Narrator
900.text: Several hours later, after falling asleep on one of the lounge chairs on the observation deck, I was startled awake by the sharp slap of a newspaper hitting the side table beside me.

901.speaker: Narrator
901.text: It was a copy of the Royal Herald, the top story being the revelation about Lespia’s involvement in the Friendship Day bombing.

902.speaker: Narrator
902.text: Smolak was standing over me with a grin on his face. Little Wiktor was in his arms.

903.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
903.text: "So this really is true then, eh, Your Majesty?"

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "Of course. I wouldn’t have ordered its publication, otherwise."

905.speaker: Player_Romus
905.text: "Every word of it. We have the evidence to prove its authenticity."

906.speaker: Player_Romus
906.text: "If it's in the paper, then it must be true."

907.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
907.text: “Well, I must say… I’m both shocked and impressed.”

909.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
909.text: "Ha! Yes. A sentiment I share as well."

910.speaker: Player_Romus
910.text: "We don't know the details yet. Ricardus may have been working in concert with Alvarez's government."

911.speaker: Player_Romus
911.text: "You are the one who wanted my cousin out of power. You didn't care whether he was innocent or not, so why should I?"

912.speaker: Player_Romus
912.text: "Ricardus may not have planted the bomb, but he stoked the hatred between Rizians and Wehzeks, making it easier for Lespians to exploit us."

913.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
913.text: "That makes a lot of sense, Your Majesty. Perhaps not to a court, but to me."

917.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
917.text: "It should be evident without explanation how crucial it is for Wehlen to support our currency."

921.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
921.text: "Just look at that. It's amazing what we can accomplish when our two nations work together."

922.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
922.text: "In honor of everything we've accomplished, I wanted to give you this small token of gratitude."

923.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
923.text: "A beautiful doorstopper, intricately carved by our most skilled of artisans."

924.speaker: Narrator
924.text: He opened his attaché case and pulled out an oblong wooden object, presenting it to us with a flourish.

926.speaker: Narrator
926.text: I couldn't help but notice the item's unique shape.

927.speaker: Player_Romus
927.text: "Yes, this truly cements our agreement's place in the annals of history."

928.speaker: Player_Romus
928.text: "I am as pleased with it as I am with our negotiations as a whole."

929.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
929.text: "I had a feeling you would like it, Your Majesty."

930.speaker: Player_Romus
930.text: "I'm honored. It is proof that neither of us has been saddled with a bum deal."

932.speaker: Narrator
932.text: Smolak opened a cabinet and took out an attaché case.

936.speaker: Narrator
936.text: I had been invited here for a long-overdue discussion regarding the return of Zille. However, my host was nowhere in sight.

940.speaker: Player_Romus
940.text: "Congratulations. I always wondered what it would be like to have a son."

941.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
941.text: "I love each of my daughters, of course. But I do feel Wiktor Jr. and I share a special bond."

945.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
945.text: "There's just one thing I'm confused about."

946.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
946.text: "Tell me, how could both he and Lespia have committed the same crime?"

947.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
947.text: "What an interesting approach to justice you have! And the rest of your family shares that outlook, I presume."

948.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
948.text: "Would you care for a drink? We've got everything."
948.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Pardoned"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Destroyed_LespianEvidence"] == false) == false)

952.speaker: Player_Romus
952.text: "You haven't offered one to President Rayne yet?"

953.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
953.text: "My friend Anton is a busy man. But so are you, I suppose."

954.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
954.text: "Our meeting three years ago didn't exactly fill me with confidence about Zille's security."

955.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
955.text: "I was very happy with how you and your security forces handled the Friendship Day bombing investigation."

956.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
956.text: "Even if the culprit wasn't whom either of us suspected."

960.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
960.text: "You're handling yourselves *very* adeptly in the war on Pales. Wehlen likes winners, Your Majesty."

961.text: "The amount of military strength you've managed to amass since your reign began is truly impressive."

968.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
968.text: "Even if you're currently wasting it on a losing war with Pales."

972.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
972.text: "It seems as if you are finally coming to your senses regarding your one-sided relationship with Rumburg."
972.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Friendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Allied"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_Scapegoats"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Destroyed_LespianEvidence"] == false))

973.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
973.text: "It troubles me that you still haven't come to your senses regarding your one-sided relationship with Rumburg."

977.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
977.text: "You caved into Supreme Lunatic Azmal and allowed in Derdians. That was very disappointing."

984.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
984.text: "Derdians remain banned from entry into your kingdom. Very nice."

988.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
988.text: "I want to thank you profusely for your country's cooperation in our Operation Bear Trap."
988.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_BludBorderBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_AntiBFF"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"]) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_DerdianBorderBan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_BludBorderBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_DerdianBorderBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_AntiBFF"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == false) == false)

989.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
989.text: "But that is not your fault, Your Majesty."

990.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
990.text: "Your withdrawal from our Operation Bear Trap was a betrayal of the highest order."
990.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_BludBorderBan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_AntiBFF"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"]) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_DerdianBorderBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_BludBorderBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_DerdianBorderBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromisesBroken_AntiBFF"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == false) == false)

994.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
994.text: "Bad news for your mercenaries, Your Majesty."

995.speaker: Narrator
995.text: He gave me a sly grin, then looked at his cocktail napkin.

999.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
999.text: "You, on the other hand.... you dare to hire the Bluds as mercenaries? That will surely backfire on you in the end."

1000.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1000.text: "You promised me that Duke Ricardus Toras would answer for his crimes."

1001.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1001.text: "When can I expect his transfer to Wehlen?"

1003.speaker: Player_Romus
1003.text: "He's staying in Rizia. I want to see his face when he gets the guillotine."

1004.speaker: Player_Romus
1004.text: "I'm sorry, but I can't fulfill that part of the bargain. Ricardus is a Toras. I can't let him die on foreign soil."

1005.speaker: Narrator
1005.text: He contorted his face into an overexaggerated frown.

1006.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1006.text: "Not the answer I was hoping for. I hope I'm at least invited to the execution."

1008.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1008.text: "Excellent. Really, it's been such a pleasure cooperating with you."

1014.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1014.text: "Not to mention that you made him Chief of Police in your capital! That doesn't count as teaching him a lesson."

1020.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1020.text: "However, reports about environmental damage to your wine industry raise doubts about the future quality and quantity of your exports."

1021.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1021.text: "Proposing to shrink your share of the Meftiem International Trade Zone while production is declining at home? The future's looking far from golden."

1028.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1028.text: "By the way, I have heard nothing but gratitude from expatriates of my country living in Rizia."
1028.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGas"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGold"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ZilleNeg_AgreementSecurity"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportArms"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Wehlen_Zille_SharedEvidence"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ZilleNeg_AgreementTrade"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_WineIndustry_EnvironmentalDamage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true)

1032.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1032.text: "Not counting the new religious tax, of course!"

1036.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1036.text: "By the way, I have heard nothing but gratitude from expatriates of my country working in Rizia."
1036.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGas"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGold"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ZilleNeg_AgreementSecurity"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportArms"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Wehlen_Zille_SharedEvidence"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ZilleNeg_AgreementTrade"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_WineIndustry_EnvironmentalDamage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_WorkersOnly"] == true)

1040.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1040.text: "Of course, they'd be even happier if you stopped subjecting their children to a forced Wruhecist education..."

1041.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1041.text: "But I trust you have their best interests at heart."

1042.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1042.text: "So that's it for the treaty. I must say, King Romus, you are a man of your word."
1042.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGas"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGold"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ZilleNeg_AgreementSecurity"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportArms"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_PromiseRicoExtradition"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Wehlen_Zille_SharedEvidence"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == false)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn08_ZilleNeg_AgreementTrade"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_WineIndustry_EnvironmentalDamage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_WehlenRights_WorkersOnly"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn08_ZilleNegotiations_TreatyKept"] == true)

1047.speaker: Player_Romus
1047.text: "We had a deal. Keeping my word was the least I could do."

1048.speaker: Player_Romus
1048.text: "Which means we can start planning for the return of Zille. Right?"

1108.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1108.text: "Oh, Your Majesty. I would be honored beyond words to join the Royal Family on such a special occasion."

1109.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1109.text: "One of my wives and I will be there."

1111.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1111.text: "Why wouldn't one? It's the most important room in the house."

1118.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1118.text: "Until then, consider Zille's return on hold."

1119.speaker: Player_Romus
1119.text: "A referendum on this land is not within your right to call. It's illegal, and I will challenge it in the Alliance of Nations."

1120.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1120.text: "Challenge accepted. We Wehzeks have a history of resilience. I've stood against a superpower; your kingdom will be no different."

1122.speaker: Player_Romus
1122.text: "My people would vote for their return. The Rizians long to come back to their homeland."

1123.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1123.text: "Then let the vote decide. We've been granted this fair process by Arcasian revolutionaries of old, and I intend to use it."

1127.speaker: Player_Romus
1127.text: "You're a world leader, President Smolak. I implore you to let go of this petty fixation."

1131.speaker: Player_Romus
1131.text: "That house holds great sentimental value to my mother. She'd never forgive me if she lost it."

1133.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1133.text: "And you know how much I hate doubt, Your Majesty."

1187.speaker: Player_Romus

1188.speaker: Narrator
1188.text: Smolak was silent for a long time. Finally, he burst out laughing.

1189.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1189.text: "I was kidding, Your Majesty! A harmless joke between friends."

1190.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1190.text: "Zille is all yours. No strings attached."

1191.speaker: Narrator
1191.text: Plush magenta seats lined the cabin, each embellished with opulent tassels and cushions embroidered with the Wehlen crest.

1192.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1192.text: "After eleven daughters, courtesy of my eight wives -- all of whom I’m still married to -- I finally have a boy! Meet Wiktor Smolak II.”

1193.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1193.text: "They'll be time for all of that soon enough."

1194.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1194.text: "We've got a long flight ahead of us, which will give us plenty of time to talk."

1195.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1195.text: "Your Golden Guard arrested Duke Ricardus Toras for his involvement in the bombing."

1197.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1197.text: "Ah, that's right. We never came to an agreement over ZiIle."

1198.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1198.text: "It was as if Rizia didn't respect Wehlen or her wishes at all."

1199.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1199.text: "You've really taken it upon yourself to better their situation."

1202.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1202.text: "But hey, if you're so eager to pawn off your family history, who am I to refuse?"

1203.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1203.text: "You seem to forget rule number one in the art of diplomatic bargaining..."

1204.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1204.text: "It's a win-win for both of us, really."

1205.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1205.text: "Nor should it. Having gold as Wehlen's backup currency naturally adds to our financial stability."

1206.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1206.text: "And the last thing I'd want is for people to think I can be taken advantage of."

1207.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1207.text: "Some of our compatriots still have respect for the democratic process, you see."

1208.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1208.text: "I was considering offering to hold a referendum in Zille, letting the people choose between staying in Wehlen or returning to Rizia."

1209.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1209.text: "In that case, I'm afraid that I have no choice but to hold a referendum in Zille regarding the issue of reunification."

1210.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1210.text: "Give me a break... In any case..."

1211.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1211.text: "Enough for me to consider opening the door for a referendum in Zille."

1212.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1212.text: "His diaper's due for a change, which I'm sure will smell better than the bull excrement in this room."

1213.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1213.text: "We cannot afford for it to resurface."

1214.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1214.text: "It's not just about him. It's about the message his arrest would send to others who seek to upend social norms."

1215.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1215.text: "I believe the decision of reunification should be up to the people of Zille to decide."

1216.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1216.text: "The way I see it, it should be up to the people of Zille to decide.

1217.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1217.text: "Having a choice in the matter is crucial."

1218.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1218.text: "Let's embrace it as an opportunity for progress and mutual understanding."

1219.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1219.text: "I'll take my leave so that you may reflect upon the implications of your decisions."

1245.speaker: Player_Romus
1245.text: "Did you have to bring a baby here? We've got real work to do."

1246.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1246.text: "I bring him everywhere, Your Majesty! No assassin would dare put a bullet through this adorable face."

1247.speaker: Narrator
1247.text: Wiktor II squealed as his father hoisted him proudly in the air.

1248.speaker: Player_Romus
1248.text: "I slept wonderfully. Now, shall we get down to business?"

1249.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1249.text: "We've waited three years for this moment. What's another five minutes?"

1250.speaker: Player_Romus
1250.text: "I'll sleep better once I know that Zille is safely back in Rizian hands."

1251.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1251.text: "Don't you trust Wehlen? We've been keeping the region safe and sound for you."

1252.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1252.text: "What an awfully convenient time for such a shocking revelation to emerge. I don't suppose you have evidence?"

1254.speaker: Player_Romus
1254.text: "I do, but it's too sensitive to share on a blimp."

1255.speaker: Player_Romus
1255.text: "You're going to have to trust me on this."

1256.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1256.text: "'Soon' isn't soon enough, Your Majesty. I've had this meeting in my diary for three years now. I'm not going to postpone it."

1257.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1257.text: "A blimp? This is an airship! And it's the most secure environment there is."

1258.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1258.text: "If you can't provide us with concrete proof, these accusations mean nothing."

1259.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
1259.text: "Come on, Your Majesty. There are limits to even our friendship."
